name: LCARS (Star Trek)
concept: Element rebuilt as a Starfleet LCARS console after Michael Okuda's design: the room list becomes the left frame, elbows sweep into a header bar on top and a composer bar at the bottom, and the timeline sits in a black content well. Variants move along canon eras (TNG 2369 -> Voyager 2375 -> Picard 2401), a usable everyday frame, a hype red alert, a cartoon Lower Decks take and a ship's-clock daylight variant.

sources.title: trekcolors R package: named LCARS series palettes 2357/2369/2375/2379 (MIT)
TheLCARS.com colour reference incl. Picard, Lower Decks, Voyager sets (reference only, EULA forbids copying code)
TheLCARS.com Lower Decks theme demo with show still (visual reference)
Dave Blass on the Titan-A and updating LCARS (Picard S3)

limits: Element Call / Jitsi / widget iframes only know light/dark: they stay Element dark inside an LCARS-coloured frame bar
Message bodies keep their original case; only chrome labels are uppercased (text-transform on user content would hurt readability and copy/paste is unaffected anyway)
The room list is virtualized (react-virtuoso): colour cycling uses [data-item-index$='N'] instead of :nth-child, row height must stay constant

Header and left panel are separate DOM subtrees: the top-left elbow is drawn as two touching pieces (frame top cap + header bar inner corner) and can misalign while the left panel is being resized; the enhancer re-measures via ResizeObserver
Icon-to-text label swaps depend on stable mx_ classes; buttons only identified by aria-label are left as recoloured icons (aria-label is localised)
Antonio is condensed: pure variants use it for message bodies at 17px+ which is readable but not great for long texts; lcars-usable switches content to Inter
Swiss 911 Ultra Compressed (canon) is commercial and not shipped; local() is not attempted
Emoji (Twemoji) and user avatars/images stay full colour
LCARS and Star Trek are CBS/Paramount property; internal use only, no show audio is shipped (beeps are synthesized)

variants.name: LCARS · TNG
variants.tagline: Enterprise-D, 2369: orange, peach, lilac and periwinkle elbows on black.

fonts.display: Antonio 500-700 caps (Swiss 911 Ultra Compressed is canon, commercial, not shipped)

variants.motion: stepwise colour cycling on the data cascade, blinking endcap on the selected room, button press brightness flash; optional two-tone chirp on press (off by default)
signature: elbow sweeps joining the room-list frame to header and composer bars
half-pill room buttons in cycling 2369 colours with black right-aligned caps labels
segmented header bar with 6px black gaps and round endcaps
arbitrary numeric codes on every block (01-HOME, 47-1138, LCARS 40274)
no icons, no borders, no shadows, no gradients: flat colour on pure black

regions.shell: pure black canvas inside one big LCARS frame: left vertical frame (spaces+room list) sweeps via a top-left elbow into the header bar and via a bottom-left elbow into the composer bar; content well = timeline
regions.spaces: vertical block stack in the frame: one rectangular colour block per space, black right/bottom-aligned caps label with a two-digit number (01 HOME, 02 …), 4px black gaps, active block = accent colour
regions.roomlist: stack of half-pill buttons (round end left, flat end butting into the frame), colours cycled by data-item-index last digit, black caps label right-aligned; selected = full accent pill with blinking endcap; unread count as black numeral block at the left end
regions.header: horizontal top bar continuing the top-left elbow; segmented colour bars with black gaps; room name in large Antonio caps right-aligned in the black area above the bar; call/info buttons = half-pills with text labels at the bar end; topic in small caps in muted colour
regions.timeline: black content well, no bubbles: each sender run gets a thin coloured left bar; sender names in caps palette colours; body text in the text colour; timestamps as right-aligned numerals; date separators as short segmented bars with the date in caps
regions.names-avatars: username colours mapped to 6 frame colours via --cpd-color-text-decorative-1..6; avatars square (--cpd-avatar-radius 0) with a 2px palette frame; default avatars = flat palette block with black initials
regions.composer: bottom elbow bar holds a black input slot with text-colour caret; send = half-pill 'TRANSMIT', attach 'DATA', emoji 'SYMBOLS', more '+' pill; labels via CSS on stable classes
regions.rightpanel: mirrored frame: right vertical bar with top-right/bottom-right elbows, card headers as caps bars, member list as pill rows
regions.buttons: primary = full pill accent fill, black caps label bottom-right aligned; secondary = pill in frame colour 2; destructive = red pill; no borders, no shadows; press = brightness(1.2)
regions.inputs: black slot with 2px frame-colour underline bar and rounded left cap; focused = accent bar; labels caps above
regions.dialogs: full-overlay mini frame: top-left elbow carrying the title in caps, bottom bar with pills ACKNOWLEDGE / CANCEL; backdrop pure black at 85%
regions.menus: context menus as vertical pill stacks on black with a coloured left bar; tooltips as small black boxes with a 2px accent bar and caps text
regions.settings: tab list rendered as the left block stack (numbered blocks), active tab accent; panel content on black with caps section bars
regions.auth: login as a standalone frame: big elbow, 'LIBRARY COMPUTER ACCESS AND RETRIEVAL SYSTEM' caps headline, 'USER AUTHORIZATION' field slots, pill buttons
regions.scrollbars: thin vertical bar in a frame colour, rounded thumb pill, black track
regions.focus: 3px accent outline with 2px black offset (pill-shaped via outline radius); never removed
regions.badges: notification counts as black numerals on accent block (pure) / pill; mentions in critical red; unread dot = small square
regions.code: code blocks as data panels: black, 1px frame-colour border-left 6px, Inconsolata, hljs mapped to palette colours
regions.iframes: calls/widgets stay Element dark; framed by a frame-colour bar with caps label
regions.icons: LCARS has no icons: in the main frame key buttons swap icons for caps text labels; remaining compound icons recoloured black on pills / palette colour on black
regions.motion: stepwise colour changes (steps(), no easing), selected endcap blink 1s steps(2), optional data cascade; all off with prefers-reduced-motion

variants.enhancer: elbow/endcap overlay pieces where pseudo-elements cannot reach, per-room deterministic codes (data-tl-code from room id hash), stardate clock in the header bar, data-cascade number block, optional WebAudio chirps (off by default, toggle pill 'AUDIO')
